senses.gloss: pr. n. pl. (Γεννησάρ, Γεννησαρέτ, a hellenization of כִּנֶּרֶת) Gennesar, Gennesaret, lake, town and district of G.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (etymology) <cite ref="C01117"><he>גנוסר</he></cite> = <he>גני שרים</he> princely gardens; <cite ref="Megillah 6a:1">Meg. 6ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00876"><he>כִּנָּרָא</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>גִּינֵּיסַרְיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:1:9">Y. Meg. I, 70ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>שני גו׳ היו</he> (corr. acc.) were there two places of the name of G.?
